integrity: The proof uses the source's exact tight-right-hand-side formula, proves that every such right-hand side is bounded by the corresponding permutahedral value, then computes normalized intrinsic subset-facet distances. Singleton inequalities independently give the matching global upper bound and force the center uniquely. Finite exact arithmetic is used only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the Pilaud--Poliakova (1,n)-Hochschild deformed-permutahedron realization and its intrinsic Euclidean metric. It does not cover general (m,n)-Hochschild polytopes, cubic realizations, or affinely equivalent models. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent general Chebyshev-center theorem for deformed permutahedra.
title: The Hochschild-lattice polytope has the exact permutahedral inradius
